AboutPage.goAuctIsBuiltToResol: [PT] GoAuct is built to resolve data friction and information asymmetry. By normalising thousands of disparate county data formats into a unified operational command center, the platform ensures transactional clarity at scale.

AboutPage.redisAndCeleryProces: Redis e Celery processam tarefas de enriquecimento estrutural de longa duração sem bloqueio de thread de UI.
AboutPage.fieldAgentSubmission: Os envios dos agentes de campo exigem uma verificação do raio GPS de 50 metros para garantir a veracidade dos dados.
AboutPage.ourPlatformIsBuiltRe: Nossa plataforma foi construída pronta para camadas de aprendizado de máquina. Os dados normalizados permitem modelagem preditiva futura para vencer licitações em leilões, análise de visão computacional para detecção de danos estruturais em telhados e indicadores de perigo inteligentes.

AboutPage.aHighPerformanceProp: Uma plataforma PropTech de alto desempenho construída para capacitar investidores, corretores de imóveis e agentes de campo com pipelines de dados limpos, mediação de tarefas por raio GPS e sincronização de leilões em todo o país.
AboutPage.goAuctIsAVerticalPro: GoAuct é um ecossistema PropTech vertical projetado para resolver a lacuna crítica entre registros fragmentados de leilões públicos e investimentos acionáveis ​​no mundo real.
AboutPage.weAreBuildingTheFirs: [PT] We are building the first fully decentralized, end-to-end operational network for property acquisition, management, and frictionless transfer.
AboutPage.transformingChaoticC: [PT] Transforming chaotic county tax auction announcements into organized, queryable data. We aggregate property details, owner information, and A+ to F AI scoring to surface the best deals instantly for global investors and licensed US realtors.
AboutPage.executePropertyAcqui: [PT] Execute property acquisitions directly. Once acquired, properties enter a private digital vault where investors can upload documentation, track ROI, and monitor ongoing renovations securely.

AboutPage.verifyProofOfOwnersh: [PT] Verify proof of ownership and lock documentation into a secure vault. Aligned with Title & Insurance companies, trade properties held under an LLC/Corp instantly with less bureaucracy.
AboutPage.investorsSpentHundre: [PT] Investors spent hundreds of hours scrubbing county portals, cross-referencing outdated PDFs, and driving miles for basic property updates with zero verified data safety.
AboutPage.realTimeNationwideSy: [PT] Real-time nationwide synchronization, data-driven deal scoring, unified watchlists, and an on-demand GPS geo-validated field marketplace to verify Structure health from your desk.
AboutPage.joinGoAuctTodayAndMa: [PT] Join GoAuct today and Master distressed asset operations with premium data precision.

TaxSystemsLandingPage.understandTheLegalSt: [PT] Understand the legal structures of tax liens, deeds, and redeemable deeds across all 50 states.
TaxSystemsLandingPage.unlikeTraditionalRea: [PT] Unlike traditional real estate, property tax enforcement is uniquely governed at the state and county level. If a property owner defaults on their tax obligations, the county enforces the sovereign right to recover those funds.
TaxSystemsLandingPage.investorsPurchaseThe: [PT] Investors purchase the right to collect the tax debt plus a statutory interest rate (up to 36% in some states). If unredeemed, the investor can foreclose.
TaxSystemsLandingPage.theCountyDirectlyFor: [PT] The county directly forecloses and auctions the deed to the property to the highest bidder, meaning instant ownership (with caveats like quiet title).
TaxSystemsLandingPage.aHybridModelEGTexasG: [PT] A hybrid model (e.g., Texas, Georgia) where you buy the deed, but the owner has a set period to redeem it by paying a substantial penalty percentage.
TaxSystemsLandingPage.insteadOfManuallyTra: [PT] Instead of manually tracking which county uses which system, our algorithm inherently understands the geographic rules. The platform scores deals based on state-specific yield maximums and structural risks.
